Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: Radian — artifact request & mapping (answers + links)

Emma — thanks, quick answers and links below.

1) Access logs: sample covers 2026-11-15 to 2026-11-21. Extraction query: SELECT timestamp, event_type, user_id_hash, resource_id, source_ip_masked FROM access_events WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-11-15' AND '2026-11-21';
Retention: platform retains auth/access events for 12 months by default; retention policy pointer: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEF-radian-sig (readme.html -> section 3.2).

2) KMS rotation evidence: We rotated the customer-root RSA key on 2026-07-02 (rotation-event-id: rot-20260702-45). Attached is a signed attestation from our infra team and a pointer to the cloud provider rotation audit (provider-proof.txt in the Drive link).

3) Key management scope: Redwood-managed keys are used for control-plane secrets and ephemeral model runtime caches. Customer BYOK is available and recommended for customer-specific data-at-rest; components that are BYOK-capable are: storage buckets (object storage), persistent model artifacts, and any customer-configured DB encryption. The control matrix (infrastructure-control-matrix-2026.xlsx) has a "scope" column with explicit tags (redwood-managed / byok / third-party).

Delivery: final artifact bundle (redwood-artifact-bundle-radian.zip) is available at the Drive link above. If you prefer a signed transfer, we can initiate a secure SFTP pull and provide checksums.

Next steps: please confirm whether you need the GUI screenshot pack or the raw console export for KMS logs; Steph will coordinate sanitization.

Regards,
Vivek
